arxiv-2308-14903.title: memory-vq : Compression for Tractable Internet-Scale Memory
arxiv-2308-14903.creator: Yury Zemlyanskiy, Michiel de Jong, Luke Vilnis, Google Research
arxiv-2308-14903.description: Abstract Retrieval augmentation is a powerful but expensive method to make language models more knowledgeable about the world. Memory-based methods like lumen de Jong et al. 2023a pre-compute token representations for retrieved passages to drastically speed up inference. However, memory also leads to much greater storage requirements from storing pre-computed representations.

arxiv-2311-15717.title: Evidence of spin density waves in La 3 Ni 2 O 7-δ
arxiv-2311-15717.creator: Kaiwen Chen, Xiangqi Liu, Jiachen Jiao, Muyuan Zou, Chengyu Jiang, Xin Li, Yixuan Luo, Qiong Wu, Ningyuan Zhang, Yanfeng Guo, Lei Shu
arxiv-2311-15717.description: Abstract The recently discovered superconductivity with critical temperature T c T_{c} up to 80 K in the double-layer Nickelate La 3 Ni 2 O 7-δ under pressure has drawn great attention. Here we report the positive muon spin relaxation ( μ + \mu^{+} SR) study of polycrystalline La 3 Ni 2 O 6.92 under ambient pressure.

arxiv-2410-07257.title: The muon beam monitor for the FAMU experiment: design, simulation, test and operation
arxiv-2410-07257.creator: R. Rossini 1,2,3∗ , G. Baldazzi 4,5 , S. Banfi 6 , M. Baruzzo 7 , R. Benocci 6,8 , R. Bertoni 6 , M. Bonesini 6,9 , S. Carsi 6,10 , D. Cirrincione 7,11 , M. Clemenza 6 , L. Colace 12,13 , A. de Bari 1,2 , C. de Vecchi 2 , E. Fasci 14,15 , R. Gaigher 6 , L. Gianfrani 14,15 , A.D. Hillier 3 , K. Ishid
arxiv-2410-07257.description: Abstract 1 FAMU is an INFN-led muonic atom physics experiment based at the RIKEN-RAL muon facility at the ISIS Neutron and Muon Source (United Kingdom). The aim of FAMU is to measure the hyperfine splitting in muonic hydrogen to determine the value of the proton Zemach radius with accuracy better than 1%.

arxiv-2512-03225.title: Convergence of a class of gradient-free optimisation schemes when the objective function is noisy, irregular, or both
arxiv-2512-03225.creator: Christophe Andrieu, Nicolas Chopin, Ettore Fincato, Mathieu Gerber
arxiv-2512-03225.description: Abstract We investigate the convergence properties of a class of iterative algorithms designed to minimize a potentially non-smooth and noisy objective function, which may be algebraically intractable and whose values may be obtained as the output of a black box.

arxiv-2602-14852.title: Lower Estimates for L 1 L_{1} -Distortion of Transportation Cost Spaces Thanks: 1 The first named author was supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant Number DMS-2546184
arxiv-2602-14852.creator: Chris Gartland 1, Mikhail Ostrovskii
arxiv-2602-14852.description: Abstract . Quantifying the degree of dissimilarity between two probability distributions on a finite metric space X X is a fundamental task in Computer Science and Computer Vision. A natural dissimilarity measurement based on optimal transport is the earth mover’s distance (EMD), also known as the Kantorovich metric or Wasserstein-1 metric.

pmc-10574633.creator: Yiping Yan, Wenpeng Lu, Taiping Tian, Nan Shu, Yiming Yang, Shutian Fan, Xianyan Han, Yunhua Ge, Peilei Xu, Chiara Emilia Cordero
pmc-10574633.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). To investigate the volatile components of Schisandra chinensis (Turcz.) Bail (commonly known as northern Schisandra) of different colors and to explore their similarities and differences, to identify the main flavor substances in the volatile components of the branch exudates of northern schisandra, and finally to establish a fingerprint map of the volatile components of the dried fruits and branch exudates of northern Schisandra of different colors, we used GC-IMS technology to analyze the volatile components of the dried fruits and branch exudates

pmc-10629713.title: The Human Blood Fluke, Schistosoma mansoni, Harbors Bacteria Throughout the Parasite's Life Cycle
pmc-10629713.creator: Fabio Formenti, Alba Cortés, Michela Deiana, Susannah Salter, Julian Parkhill, Matt Berriman, Gabriel Rinaldi, Cinzia Cantacessi
pmc-10629713.description: While symbiotic relationships between invertebrates and bacteria have been extensively described, studies of microbial communities inhabiting parasitic worms remain scarce. Exploring the microbiota associated with helminths responsible for major infectious diseases will inform on parasite biology, host-pathogen interactions, and disease pathophysiology. We investigated the presence of microorganisms inhabiting tissues of the human parasite Schistosoma mansoni.

pmc-11511163.title: Corrosion Properties of the Composite Coatings Formed on PEO Pretreated AlMg3 Aluminum Alloy by Dip-Coating in Polyvinylidene Fluoride-Polytetrafluoroethylene Suspension
pmc-11511163.creator: Vladimir S Egorkin, Igor E Vyaliy, Andrey S Gnedenkov, Ulyana V Kharchenko, Sergey L Sinebryukhov, Sergey V Gnedenkov, Zhanjun Wu, Jia Yan, Shichao Li, Ling Liu, Tao Sun
pmc-11511163.description: This paper presents the results of an evaluation of corrosion properties of PEO pretreated AlMg3 aluminum alloy samples with polymer coatings obtained by dip-coating in a suspension of superdispersed polytetrafluoroethylene (SPTFE) in a solution of polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) in N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone at different PVDF:SPTFE ratios (1:1, 1:3, 1:5, and 1:10).

pmc-11691311.title: ETHNORACIAL DIFFERENCES IN FORMAL AND INFORMAL VOLUNTEERISM AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN THE US: A FOCUS ON ASIAN AMERICANS
pmc-11691311.creator: Patrick Ho Lam Lai
pmc-11691311.description: This study questions the assertion that socioeconomic resources are the primary driver behind ethnoracial disparities observed in volunteerism among older adults. Existing literature fails to account for why Asian older adults, with resources comparable to Whites, exhibit lower volunteerism rates.

pmc-12498195.title: Effects on LuxR‐Regulated Bioluminescence of Cyclodextrin‐Acyl‐L‐Homoserine Lactone Hybrids
pmc-12498195.creator: Nicolas Tinet, David Lesur, Yves Queneau, Laurent Soulère, Florence Djedaini‐Pilard, Véronique Bonnet
pmc-12498195.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this work, acyl homoserine lactones (AHLs) are grafted, the most studied signaling molecules in many Gram‐negative bacteria, onto cyclodextrins (CDs) by copper‐catalyzed azide–alkyne cycloaddition “click” coupling between alkynyl‐AHLs and 6‐azido‐CDs derived from α‐ and β‐CD, native or methylated. Attaching biomolecules onto a CD scaffold is a known strategy to enhance their properties, but designing CD‐AHL conjugates has never been reported.

pmc-12556248.title: Anxiety and depression as predictors of NEET in young adulthood: A Swedish national cohort study
pmc-12556248.creator: J Wahlström, V Östberg, S B Låftman
pmc-12556248.description: BackgroundYoung people not in education, employment, or training (NEET) are a growing concern in European societies. While mental health problems are established risk factors for NEET status, the specific roles of anxiety and depression - and their co-occurrence - remains understudied.

pmc-12666703.title: Cathepsin C-driven enhancement of neutrophil extracellular trap formation contributes to acute lung injury
pmc-12666703.creator: Xinyu Wu, Huijun Liu, Qingwu Qin, Lin Yuan, Ye Yao, Xizi Du, Qiuyan Qin, Leyuan Wang, Qianyu Zhao, Ling Qin, Yang Xiang, Ming Yang, Xiaoqun Qin, Chi Liu
pmc-12666703.description: SummaryAcute lung injury (ALI) is a severe pulmonary inflammatory disease with high morbidity and mortality rates. The pulmonary inflammatory phenotype of ALI is driven by the excessive aggregation and activation of neutrophils, triggering a cytokine storm. Notably, the extensive formation of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) has been demonstrated to play a critical role in ALI.

pmc-12837673.title: The Longitudinal Impact of Father Presence on Adolescent Depressive Symptoms: The Mediating Role of Emotion Beliefs and Emotion Regulation
pmc-12837673.creator: Dan Xu, Haowen Peng, Zongkui Zhou, Jing Wang
pmc-12837673.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Adolescence is a developmental period marked by heightened vulnerability to depressive symptoms. Although prior research highlights the significance of father presence in adolescent mental health, longitudinal evidence clarifying both its direct and indirect effects remains scarce. Methods: The present study used a three-wave longitudinal design to examine whether emotion beliefs and emotion regulation processes explain the link between father presence and depressive symptoms. Participants included 1074 Chinese adolescents (Mage = 16.06, SD = 0.43, girls = 52.89%).

pmc-13209262.title: Genetic Fingerprint of Klebsiella pneumoniae Virulence: A Systematic Review
pmc-13209262.creator: Carlos Andrés Aldana-Ortega, Alexander José Pérez-Villadiego, Yohelys Monterrosa-Taborda, Alberto Angulo-Ortíz, Orfa Inés Contreras-Martínez
pmc-13209262.description: Background: Klebsiella pneumoniae is a globally relevant pathogen whose growing association between hypervirulence and antimicrobial resistance represents a major public health challenge. Methods: A systematic review was performed following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Studies published between 2005 and 2025 were searched in Google Scholar, Scopus, PubMed and Science Direct that reported the molecular detection of virulence genes in clinical isolates.

pmc-13273818.title: Impact of peripheral optical errors in age-related macular degeneration
pmc-13273818.creator: Abinaya Priya Venkataraman, Robert Rosén, Marrie van der Mooren, Aixa Alarcón Heredia, Dmitry Romashchenko, Carmen Cánovas Vidal, Linda Lundström

pmc-13357330.title: Low-dose radiotherapy combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors in advanced malignancies: a real-world exploratory study
pmc-13357330.creator: Kai Xin, Liping Deng, Meiqing Ding, Mengmeng Feng, Xiahui Wu, Lijing Zhu
pmc-13357330.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPatients with advanced malignancies often have limited treatment options after failure of systemic therapy, and the prognosis remains poor. Low-dose radiotherapy (LDRT) has been proposed to enhance antitumor immunity and may improve the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs).

pmc-13678352.title: Investigation of MHC-B linked LEI0258 marker diversity in various chicken populations
pmc-13678352.creator: Prabuddha Manjula, Denuwan Lasitha Perera, Roshani Fernando, Minjun Kim, Eunjin Cho, Jun Heon Lee
pmc-13678352.description: The variable number tandem repeat (VNTR) LEI0258 is the most polymorphic marker in the chicken major histocompatibility complex (MHC) B region. Unlike other microsatellite markers, LEI0258 is characterized by R13 and R12 repeat motifs, resulting in greater allele variation across chicken breeds.

pmc-13689028.title: Guidewire-assisted en bloc resection of periorifice non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer: a retrospective case series
pmc-13689028.creator: Qiu Yao, Hui Niu, Huizhong Jiang, Lijun Xu, Yachen Zang, Wei Wu, Jin Zhu, Boxin Xue
pmc-13689028.description: BackgroundEn bloc resection of bladder tumor provides improved specimen quality compared with conventional transurethral resection of bladder tumor; however, periorifice tumors remain technically challenging due to the risk of ureteral injury. We reviewed the perioperative and short-term outcomes of patients who underwent guidewire-assisted en bloc resection for periorifice non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
